loans.description: One row per SBA 7(a) or 504 loan approved in the asked fiscal years (FY1991 on), columns as published (borrower, lender or CDC, GrossApproval, SBAGuaranteedApproval (7(a) only), ApprovalFY, ProcessingMethod, NaicsCode, ProjectState, LoanStatus, PaidInFullDate, ChargeOffDate, GrossChargeOffAmount ...) plus loan_status_code. The files are found on the dataset page (their names carry the quarter-end as-of date), streamed to a temporary file and filtered while reading.

approval_fy.desc: approval fiscal year(s): one year or a list

start_fy.desc: first approval fiscal year of a range (with end_fy; default end: the latest)

end_fy.desc: last approval fiscal year of a range

state.desc: borrower state(s) (BorrState): USPS code, FIPS code or name

project_state.desc: project state(s) (ProjectState): USPS code, FIPS code or name

loan_status.desc: loan_status_code(s) to keep: PIF, CHGOFF, CANCLD, UNDISBURSED, EXEMPT, CLOSED

processing_method.desc: ProcessingMethod value(s) as published, case-insensitive ("SBA Express Program", "Preferred Lenders Program", "504 Basic" ...)

columns.desc: columns to keep, e.g. ["ApprovalFY", "GrossApproval", "LoanStatus"]; loan_status_code is always kept

cohorts.description: Totals per approval fiscal year (cohort), optionally by more columns (group_by), computed while reading the same loan-level files with the same filters: loan counts by status, gross approval and SBA-guaranteed dollars (all loans and disbursed loans), and the gross charge-off amount. One row per ApprovalFY x group.

approval_fy.desc: approval fiscal year(s): one year or a list

start_fy.desc: first approval fiscal year of a range

end_fy.desc: last approval fiscal year of a range

loan_status.desc: loan_status_code(s) to keep (rarely wanted here: it changes the base)

group_by.desc: extra grouping columns: any of BorrState, ProjectState, ProcessingMethod, naics2 (NAICS sector, first 2 digits), NaicsCode, BusinessType, BusinessAge, FixedorVariableInterestInd, TermInMonths, RevolverStatus, SoldSecMrktInd, loan_status_code
